extracted.intended_audience: Users of Mathematics Stack Exchange (askers and answerers, especially new or prospective users)
extracted.subtask_description: Site-level guidelines for asking and answering mathematics questions, formatting math, moderation, reputation, account management, and acceptable behavior on Mathematics Stack Exchange.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tour / Here's how it works
rubrics_metrics.description: Quick overview of how the site works for new users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Take the 2-minute tour. Key points shown: Anybody can ask a question; Anybody can answer; The best answers are voted up and rise to the top.

rubrics_metrics.name: What topics can I ask about here?
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines the topical scope of acceptable questions for the Mathematics site.

rubrics_metrics.name: What types of questions should I avoid asking?
rubrics_metrics.description: Identifies question formats or subject-matter that are inappropriate for the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: What does it mean if a question is "closed" or "on hold"?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains closure reasons, the 'on hold' state, and what closure implies for a question.

rubrics_metrics.name: I've thought better of my question; can I delete it?
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes when and how a user can delete their own question and any limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Why and how are some questions deleted?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains the policies and reasons for question deletion by community or moderators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Code of Conduct
rubrics_metrics.description: Expected behavior and community standards for interactions on the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: How can I format mathematics here?
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on posting and rendering mathematical notation (LaTeX/MathJax) and formatting best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expected Behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: General expectations for how users should behave and interact on the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: How do I find topics I'm interested in?
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice on searching, following tags, and locating content of interest on the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to not be a spammer
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and rules to avoid posting spam or promotional content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who are the site moderators, and what is their role here?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains moderator responsibilities and how they enforce site rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Why is voting important?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains the role of voting in surfacing good content and community curation.

rubrics_metrics.name: What is reputation? How do I earn (and lose) it?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains reputation points, how they are gained and lost, and what they represent.

rubrics_metrics.name: What is a locked post?
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes what a locked post is and why posts may be locked.

rubrics_metrics.name: What is a bounty? How can I start one?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains the bounty system for promoting questions and how to offer a bounty.

rubrics_metrics.name: What does it mean when an answer is "accepted"?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains the accepted-answer mechanic and its implications for askers and answerers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Why and how are some answers deleted?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains policies and reasons for deletion of answers by community or moderators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Why are answers no longer being accepted from my account?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains answer bans and automated restrictions on posting answers from accounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: How do I write a good answer?
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on composing helpful, clear, and well-formatted answers that address the question.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to reference material written by others
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy and recommendations for citing, quoting, and attributing third-party material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Badges
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about site badges as recognition for contributions and how they are awarded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privileges
rubrics_metrics.description: List and explanation of privileges that users earn at different reputation levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: I accidentally created two accounts; how do I merge them?
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure and policy for merging multiple user accounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: How do I add or remove login credentials from my account?
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for managing login methods and linked credentials for your account.

rubrics_metrics.name: I lost my password; how do I reset it?
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for recovering access to an account and resetting passwords.

rubrics_metrics.name: How do I delete my account?
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure, consequences, and limitations for account deletion on the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: What is the license for the content I post?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains the licensing terms for user contributions (cc by-sa 3.0 with attribution required).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Site footer: user contributions licensed under cc by-sa 3.0 with attribution required.
